main_text.p: autem, inquit, [illegible, ~12 letters] Discursus qui affectus quidè moveant, sed ad metam mutiquam pertingant, nec probationes & argumenta manifesta exhibeant. Meminit hujus libri [illegible, ~10 letters] Abraham Zacut in Juchasin, & præcipuum eorum qui horum tractatuum authores censentur, fuisse [illegible, ~4 letters] apud Gregorium [illegible, ~4 letters] Zaid Ebn Raphaab, floruit circa annum H. 373. Quid de ipsis censuerit acutissimus Philosophus Ebn Sayeg, patet ex his ipsius verbis, ubi de sententia minus sibi probatâ loquitur, [illegible, ~12 letters] Non est autem haec sententia cujusquam ex antiquioribus, verum sententia Echwano Sfapha à veritate aberrantium. Ebn Sayeg autem iste est [illegible, ~10 letters] Abu Bacr Mohammed Ebn Bajjah vulgò Ebnul Sayeg appellatus, qui obiit anno 533. vel juxta alios 525, teste Ebn Chalec. &c. veneno sublatus.
p 211.[illegible, ~8 letters] AlHasan Basrienfis] [illegible, ~10 letters] Abu Said AlHafan Ebn Abil-Häfan, &c. AlBafri obiit anno H. 110. annos natus 88. Ebn Chalec. AlJannab. &c.

212.[illegible, ~6 letters] AlSamaani ] [illegible, ~12 letters] Abu Saad AbdolCarim Ebn Abi Bacr Mohammed Affamaani[?] AlMarwazi: feil. patriam habens [illegible, ~3 letters] Affamaani autem à tribu seu familiâ Arabum denominatus. Natus est anno H. 506.mortuus 562.

page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew lines are illegible to me at the letter level and are marked with approximate letter counts; they are not transcribed. "Affamaani" is uncertain: the ff in italic could be a double s. Long s has been normalised to s. Number "525" and "533" read as printed.
